questions.prompt: Which decorator turns a class into a component?
questions.explanation: @Component links a class to its template, styles, and selector.

questions.prompt: Which are valid built-in control flow blocks? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Angular provides @if, @for, and @switch. There is no @while block.

questions.prompt: Every @for block must include a ____ expression for performance.
questions.explanation: The track expression gives Angular a stable identity for each item.
